description: This file appears to be a shell script used for testing Git's CRLF (Carriage Return Line Feed) conversion behaviors. It defines setup procedures, various test cases, and utility functions related to checking and manipulating CRLF and LF line endings, as well as their interactions with Git configurations and attributes.

methods.name: has_cr
methods.description: Checks if a given file contains CR (carriage return) characters by tr and grep.

methods.name: munge_cr
methods.description: Adds or removes CRs to a disk file in-place based on the provided mode ('append' or 'remove').

methods.name: cr_to_Q_no_NL
methods.description: Converts CR characters to 'Q', removes linefeeds for testing purposes.
